o.A: Environmental conditions, such as radiation or electromagnetic fields affecting hardware or firmware
o.B: Executing too many test cases in the same test cycle
o.C: Designing test cases before the code is available
o.D: Maintaining traceability between test cases and requirements

items.exEn: Failures can be caused by defects and also by environmental conditions such as radiation or electromagnetic fields.
items.qAr: إلى جانب الـ defects في البرمجيات، ما الذي يمكن أن يسبّب failures أيضًا وفق المنهج؟
items.exAr: قد تنتج الـ failures عن defects، وكذلك عن ظروف بيئية مثل الإشعاع أو المجالات الكهرومغناطيسية.

items.q: What is the main purpose of performing root cause analysis?

o.A: To identify the person responsible for introducing each defect
o.B: To reproduce the failure in the test environment
o.C: To identify the underlying reasons for problems so that similar defects can be reduced or prevented in future
o.D: To calculate the number of test cases needed for the next release

items.exEn: Root cause analysis identifies fundamental causes so that addressing them can prevent or reduce similar defects, leading to process improvement.
items.qAr: ما الهدف الرئيسي من إجراء root cause analysis؟
items.exAr: يحدّد root cause analysis الأسباب الجذرية للمشكلات، ومعالجتها تمنع أو تقلّل defects مشابهة في المستقبل وتحسّن العمليات.

items.q: A test fails, but investigation shows that the expected result written in the test case was wrong and the software actually behaves correctly. What is this an example of?

o.A: A false negative
o.B: A false positive
o.C: A root cause
o.D: A regression

items.exEn: Not all unexpected results are failures; a false positive is a reported failure where no defect exists in the test object, e.g. due to a defect in the testware.
items.qAr: يفشل test، لكن التحقيق يُظهر أن النتيجة المتوقعة المكتوبة في الـ test case كانت خاطئة وأن البرنامج يعمل بشكل صحيح. ما الذي يمثّله هذا؟
items.exAr: ليست كل نتيجة غير متوقعة failure؛ فالـ false positive هو الإبلاغ عن failure دون وجود defect في الـ test object، مثلًا بسبب defect في الـ testware.

items.q: A team reviews user stories and acceptance criteria before any code is written, and testers design tests in parallel with development. Which testing principle is the team mainly applying?

o.A: Exhaustive testing is impossible
o.B: Defects cluster together
o.C: Tests wear out
o.D: Early testing saves time and money

items.exEn: Removing defects early prevents them from causing derived defects and failures later, reducing cost.
items.qAr: يراجع فريق الـ user stories والـ acceptance criteria قبل كتابة أي كود، ويصمّم المختبِرون الاختبارات بالتوازي مع التطوير. أي مبدأ اختبار يطبّقه الفريق أساسًا؟
items.exAr: إزالة الـ defects مبكرًا تمنع ظهور defects وfailures مشتقة لاحقًا، فتقلّ التكلفة.

items.q: In the last three releases, most reported failures came from the payment module, which is a small part of the system. How should the test manager use this observation for the next release?

o.A: Reduce testing of the payment module because its defects are already known
o.B: Spread the test effort equally across all modules to avoid bias
o.C: Stop regression testing of the other modules
o.D: Use it as an input to risk-based testing and focus more test effort on the payment module

items.exEn: Defects cluster together; predicted and observed clusters are an important input to risk-based testing.
items.qAr: في آخر ثلاثة releases، جاءت معظم الـ failures المبلَّغ عنها من وحدة الدفع، وهي جزء صغير من النظام. كيف يجب أن يستفيد مدير الاختبار من هذه الملاحظة في الـ release القادم؟
items.exAr: الـ defects تتجمّع معًا، والتجمّعات المتوقعة والملاحَظة مُدخل مهم في risk-based testing.

items.q: A regression test suite has been run unchanged in every sprint for a year and has found no new defects for months, while users keep reporting failures in production. What is the MOST appropriate action?

o.A: Run the same suite more frequently
o.B: Review and modify the existing tests and write new tests
o.C: Stop running the regression suite because it no longer finds defects
o.D: Conclude that the areas covered by the suite are defect-free

items.exEn: Tests wear out: repeating the same tests becomes less effective at finding new defects, so tests and test data should be modified and new tests written.
items.qAr: تُنفَّذ regression test suite دون تغيير في كل sprint منذ سنة، ولم تكشف أي defects جديدة منذ أشهر، بينما يستمر المستخدمون في الإبلاغ عن failures في الإنتاج. ما الإجراء الأنسب؟
items.exAr: الاختبارات تفقد فعاليتها (tests wear out) عند تكرارها، لذا يجب تعديل الاختبارات الحالية وبياناتها وكتابة اختبارات جديدة.

items.q: A company develops both a safety-critical infusion pump controller and a casual mobile game. The test manager plans formal, highly documented testing for the pump and a lighter, exploratory approach for the game. Which principle justifies this?

o.A: Absence-of-defects fallacy
o.B: Testing shows the presence, not the absence of defects
o.C: Testing is context dependent
o.D: Defects cluster together

items.exEn: There is no single universal approach; testing is done differently in different contexts.
items.qAr: تطوّر شركة نظام تحكّم لمضخة دواء حرجة للسلامة ولعبة جوال بسيطة. يخطط مدير الاختبار لاختبار رسمي وموثّق بدقة للمضخة، ونهج أخفّ واستكشافي للعبة. أي مبدأ يبرّر ذلك؟
items.exAr: لا يوجد نهج اختبار واحد يناسب كل الحالات؛ فالاختبار يُنفَّذ بطرق مختلفة حسب السياق.

items.q: After a long test cycle with no open defects, the project manager asks the tester to sign a statement that the system is 'defect-free'. What is the BEST response based on the testing principles?

o.A: Explain that testing reduces the probability of undiscovered defects but cannot prove that there are none
o.B: Sign the statement, since all planned tests have passed
o.C: Agree to sign only after every possible input combination has been tested
o.D: Sign it only for the modules that had the highest number of defects

items.exEn: Testing shows the presence, not the absence of defects; it reduces the probability of remaining undiscovered defects but cannot prove correctness.
items.qAr: بعد دورة اختبار طويلة دون defects مفتوحة، يطلب مدير المشروع من المختبِر توقيع إقرار بأن النظام «خالٍ من الـ defects». ما أفضل رد بناءً على مبادئ الاختبار؟
items.exAr: الاختبار يُظهر وجود الـ defects لا غيابها؛ فهو يقلّل احتمال بقاء defects غير مكتشفة لكنه لا يثبت خلوّ النظام منها.

items.q: A registration form has 12 fields, each accepting many values, and the possible combinations are far too numerous to test in the available time. What does the syllabus recommend?

o.A: Test every combination with automation, since automation removes this limitation
o.B: Use test techniques, test case prioritization and risk-based testing to focus the test effort
o.C: Test only the first field, since defects in the other fields are unlikely
o.D: Delay the release until all combinations have been tested

items.exEn: Exhaustive testing is impossible except in trivial cases; test techniques, prioritization and risk-based testing should be used to focus effort.
items.qAr: نموذج تسجيل يحتوي على 12 حقلًا، يقبل كل منها قيمًا كثيرة، وعدد التركيبات الممكنة أكبر بكثير مما يسمح به الوقت المتاح. بماذا يوصي المنهج؟
items.exAr: الاختبار الشامل مستحيل إلا في الحالات البسيطة، لذا تُستخدم test techniques وتحديد أولويات الـ test cases وrisk-based testing لتركيز الجهد.

items.q: During test execution, the test manager notices that progress is behind schedule and decides to re-prioritize the remaining tests and add another tester. Which test activity is this?

o.A: Test monitoring and test control
o.B: Test planning
o.C: Test analysis
o.D: Test completion

items.exEn: Test monitoring compares actual progress against the plan; test control takes actions such as re-prioritizing or reallocating resources.
items.qAr: أثناء تنفيذ الاختبارات، يلاحظ مدير الاختبار أن التقدّم متأخر عن الجدول، فيقرّر إعادة ترتيب أولويات الاختبارات المتبقية وإضافة مختبِر آخر. ما هو نشاط الاختبار هذا؟
items.exAr: يقارن test monitoring التقدّم الفعلي بالخطة، ويتخذ test control إجراءات مثل إعادة ترتيب الأولويات أو إعادة توزيع الموارد.

items.q: Which task is part of test implementation?

o.A: Defining the test objectives and test approach in the test plan
o.B: Analyzing the test basis to identify testable features and test conditions
o.C: Comparing actual results with expected results
o.D: Organizing test cases into test procedures, assembling test suites and preparing test data and the test environment

items.exEn: Test implementation creates or acquires the testware needed for execution: test procedures, test suites, test data, test environment and the execution schedule.
items.qAr: أي مهمة تُعدّ جزءًا من test implementation؟
items.exAr: في test implementation يُجهَّز الـ testware اللازم للتنفيذ: test procedures وtest suites وtest data والـ test environment وجدول التنفيذ.

items.q: At the end of a project, the team archives the testware for reuse, hands the test environment over to the operations team and holds a meeting to capture lessons learned. Which test activity are they performing?

o.A: Test execution
o.B: Test monitoring and test control
o.C: Test completion
o.D: Test implementation

items.exEn: Test completion includes archiving testware, handing over the test environment, analysing lessons learned and producing a test completion report.
items.qAr: في نهاية مشروع، يؤرشف الفريق الـ testware لإعادة استخدامه، ويسلّم الـ test environment لفريق التشغيل، ويعقد اجتماعًا لتوثيق الدروس المستفادة. أي نشاط اختبار ينفّذون؟
items.exAr: يشمل test completion أرشفة الـ testware وتسليم الـ test environment وتحليل الدروس المستفادة وإعداد test completion report.

items.q: Which of the following is performed during test execution?

o.A: Identifying and prioritizing test conditions
o.B: Writing the test completion report
o.C: Running tests, comparing actual results with expected results and reporting anomalies
o.D: Designing test cases and identifying coverage items

items.exEn: Test execution includes running tests, comparing actual and expected results, analysing anomalies and reporting defects.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُنفَّذ أثناء test execution؟
items.exAr: يشمل test execution تشغيل الاختبارات، ومقارنة النتائج الفعلية بالمتوقعة، وتحليل الحالات الشاذة والإبلاغ عن الـ defects.

items.q: Which testware is typically produced by test monitoring and test control?

o.A: Test conditions
o.B: Test procedures and test suites
o.C: Defect reports and test logs
o.D: Test progress reports and documentation of control directives

items.exEn: Test monitoring and control produce test progress reports, documentation of control directives and risk information.
items.qAr: أي testware يُنتَج عادةً من test monitoring وtest control؟
items.exAr: ينتج عن test monitoring وtest control تقارير التقدّم (test progress reports) وتوثيق قرارات التحكم ومعلومات المخاطر.

items.q: Which of the following is an example of a contextual factor that influences how the test process is carried out?

o.A: Team members' skills and project constraints such as scope, time and budget
o.B: The glossary definition of a failure
o.C: The seven testing principles
o.D: The relationship between errors, defects and failures

items.exEn: Contextual factors include stakeholders, team skills, business domain, technical factors, project constraints, organizational factors, the SDLC and tools.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي مثال على عامل سياقي يؤثّر في طريقة تنفيذ عملية الاختبار؟
items.exAr: من العوامل السياقية: أصحاب المصلحة، ومهارات الفريق، ومجال العمل، والعوامل التقنية، وقيود المشروع، والعوامل التنظيمية، والـ SDLC، والأدوات.

items.q: How can traceability of test results to risks be used?

o.A: To determine which developer introduced the most defects
o.B: To evaluate the level of residual risk in a test object
o.C: To generate test cases automatically from the risk register
o.D: To replace the test completion report

items.exEn: Traceability of test results to risks can be used to evaluate the level of residual risk in a test object.
items.qAr: كيف يمكن الاستفادة من traceability بين نتائج الاختبار والمخاطر؟
items.exAr: تتيح traceability بين نتائج الاختبار والمخاطر تقييم مستوى المخاطر المتبقية (residual risk) في الـ test object.

items.q: Which activities are mainly the focus of the testing role, as opposed to the test management role?

o.A: Test analysis, test design, test implementation and test execution
o.B: Test planning, test monitoring and test control, and test completion
o.C: Defining the organizational test policy and approving the budget
o.D: Debugging and fixing the defects found during testing

items.exEn: The testing role focuses on the engineering side: analysis, design, implementation and execution; test management covers planning, monitoring and control, and completion.
items.qAr: أي الأنشطة يركّز عليها أساسًا دور testing، مقارنةً بدور test management؟
items.exAr: يركّز دور testing على الجانب الهندسي: التحليل والتصميم والتجهيز والتنفيذ، بينما يغطي test management التخطيط والمراقبة والتحكم والإكمال.

items.q: In Agile software development, how is the test management role typically handled?

o.A: Only by an external test manager from another company
o.B: Some test management tasks may be handled by the Agile team, while tasks spanning multiple teams may be done by test managers outside the team
o.C: Only by the product owner
o.D: It is not needed, because Agile teams do not plan or monitor testing

items.exEn: In Agile, some test management tasks may be handled by the team itself; tasks spanning several teams or the organization may be done by test managers outside the team.
items.qAr: في Agile software development، كيف يُدار دور test management عادةً؟
items.exAr: في Agile قد يتولى الفريق نفسه بعض مهام test management، أما المهام التي تمتد عبر عدة فرق أو على مستوى المؤسسة فقد يتولاها test managers من خارج الفريق.

items.q: Shortly before a release, a tester finds several serious failures. The developers are under pressure and tend to react defensively to defect reports. What is the BEST way for the tester to communicate the findings?

o.A: Escalate directly to senior management without informing the developers
o.B: Delay reporting until after the release to avoid conflict
o.C: Point out which developer was responsible for each defect
o.D: Report the information constructively and factually, focusing on the product and the shared goal of better quality

items.exEn: Testing can be perceived as destructive, so good communication skills are needed to report findings constructively and objectively.
items.qAr: قبيل release بفترة قصيرة، يكتشف مختبِر عدة failures خطيرة. المطوّرون تحت ضغط ويميلون إلى ردّ فعل دفاعي تجاه الـ defect reports. ما أفضل طريقة لينقل المختبِر ما وجده؟
items.exAr: قد يُنظر إلى الاختبار على أنه نشاط هدّام، لذا يحتاج المختبِر إلى مهارات تواصل جيدة لعرض النتائج بطريقة بنّاءة وموضوعية.

items.q: Which of the following is an example of the whole-team approach?

o.A: Testers work in a separate team and receive the build only after development is finished
o.B: Only testers are responsible for the quality of the product
o.C: Testers collaborate with business representatives to create suitable acceptance tests, and with developers to agree on the test strategy and test automation approach
o.D: Developers are not allowed to write tests, in order to preserve tester independence

items.exEn: In the whole-team approach everyone shares responsibility for quality; testers work closely with business representatives and developers.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي مثال على الـ whole-team approach؟
items.exAr: في الـ whole-team approach يتحمّل الجميع مسؤولية الجودة، ويعمل المختبِرون عن قرب مع ممثلي العمل والمطوّرين.

items.q: Which is a potential DRAWBACK of independent testing?

o.A: Independent testers may recognize different kinds of failures than the author would
o.B: Developers may lose a sense of responsibility for quality
o.C: Independent testers can challenge assumptions made by stakeholders
o.D: Independent testers bring a different perspective from the author

items.exEn: Drawbacks of independence include isolation from developers, testers seen as a bottleneck, and developers losing a sense of responsibility for quality.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي سلبية محتمل في الاختبار المستقل (independent testing)؟
items.exAr: من سلبيات الاستقلالية: عزلة المختبِرين عن المطوّرين، واعتبارهم bottleneck، وفقدان المطوّرين إحساسهم بالمسؤولية عن الجودة.

items.q: Which of the following provides the HIGHEST level of test independence?

o.A: Testers from outside the organization
o.B: Testers from a different team within the same organization
o.C: Developers testing a colleague's code within the same team
o.D: The author testing their own work product

items.exEn: Independence ranges from none (author) through peers and other teams within the organization up to testers from outside the organization.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يوفّر أعلى مستوى من استقلالية الاختبار؟
items.exAr: تتدرّج الاستقلالية من انعدامها (الكاتب نفسه) إلى الزملاء ثم فرق أخرى داخل المؤسسة، وصولًا إلى أعلاها: مختبِرون من خارج المؤسسة.

items.q: A project follows a sequential development model. How does this model typically affect testing?

o.A: Testers take part in reviews and test design early, but dynamic testing is usually only possible later, once executable code exists
o.B: Dynamic testing starts in the first phase because code is produced in every iteration
o.C: Testing is postponed entirely until all development work is complete, including reviews
o.D: Static testing is not possible because no work products are produced before coding

items.exEn: In sequential models testers join requirements reviews, analysis and design early, but executable code usually arrives late, so dynamic testing comes later.
items.qAr: يتبع مشروع ما نموذج تطوير تسلسليًا (sequential). كيف يؤثر هذا النموذج عادةً على الاختبار؟
items.exAr: في النماذج التسلسلية يشارك المختبِرون مبكرًا في مراجعة المتطلبات والـ test analysis والـ test design، لكن الكود القابل للتنفيذ يأتي متأخرًا، لذلك يتأخر الـ dynamic testing.

items.q: A team notices that its component tests and system tests repeatedly check the same things, wasting effort. Which good testing practice, applicable to any SDLC, addresses this problem?

o.A: Every development activity should have a corresponding test activity
o.B: Each test level should have specific and distinct test objectives
o.C: Testers should be involved in reviewing work products as soon as drafts are available
o.D: Test analysis and design for a test level should begin during the corresponding development phase

items.exEn: Giving each test level specific, different objectives keeps testing appropriately comprehensive while avoiding redundancy.
items.qAr: لاحظ فريق أن الـ component tests والـ system tests تفحص الأشياء نفسها بشكل متكرر، مما يهدر الجهد. أي ممارسة اختبار جيدة، تنطبق على أي SDLC، تعالج هذه المشكلة؟
items.exAr: تحديد test objectives خاصة ومختلفة لكل test level يجعل الاختبار شاملًا بالقدر المناسب ويتجنب التكرار.

items.q: According to good testing practices, when should testers start reviewing work products such as requirements or user stories?

o.A: Only after the work products have been formally approved and baselined
o.B: After the related code has been delivered to the test environment
o.C: As soon as drafts of these work products are available
o.D: During the test completion activity at the end of the project

items.exEn: Good practice is for testers to review work products as soon as drafts are available, so earlier testing and defect detection support shift-left.
items.qAr: وفقًا لممارسات الاختبار الجيدة، متى يجب أن يبدأ المختبِرون بمراجعة الـ work products مثل المتطلبات أو الـ user stories؟
items.exAr: الممارسة الجيدة أن يراجع المختبِرون الـ work products بمجرد توفر مسوداتها، فيُكتشف الـ defect مبكرًا وهذا يدعم الـ shift-left.

items.q: A developer first writes a small automated test that fails, then writes just enough code to make it pass, and then refactors the code. The cycle is repeated for every small piece of functionality. Which approach is the developer using?

o.A: Behavior-driven development (BDD)
o.B: Acceptance test-driven development (ATDD)
o.C: Exploratory testing
o.D: Test-driven development (TDD)

items.exEn: TDD directs coding through test cases written first: write a failing test, code until it passes, then refactor, iteratively.
items.qAr: يكتب مطوّر أولًا test آليًا صغيرًا يفشل، ثم يكتب الحد الأدنى من الكود ليجعله ينجح، ثم يعمل refactoring للكود، ويكرر الدورة لكل جزء صغير من الوظائف. أي approach يستخدم هذا المطوّر؟
items.exAr: الـ TDD يوجّه كتابة الكود عن طريق test cases تُكتب أولًا: test يفشل، ثم كود حتى ينجح، ثم refactoring، بشكل تكراري.

items.q: Which statement is TRUE for TDD, ATDD and BDD alike?

o.A: They replace the need for any testing at higher test levels
o.B: Tests are defined before the code is written, and the tests may persist as automated tests for future regression
o.C: They are only applicable in sequential development models
o.D: Tests are written by testers only, after development is finished

items.exEn: All three test-first approaches apply early testing and shift-left by defining tests before code, and the tests can remain as automated regression tests.
items.qAr: أي عبارة صحيحة بالنسبة لـ TDD وATDD وBDD معًا؟
items.exAr: الثلاثة approaches من نوع test-first تطبّق الاختبار المبكر والـ shift-left لأن الـ tests تُعرَّف قبل الكود، ويمكن أن تبقى كـ automated tests للـ regression لاحقًا.

items.q: Before development of a user story starts, the product owner, a developer and a tester write scenarios such as: "Given the cart contains 3 items, When the user removes one item, Then the cart total is updated". The scenarios are easy for business stakeholders to understand and are later automated. Which approach is being used?

o.A: Test-driven development (TDD)
o.B: Static analysis
o.C: Behavior-driven development (BDD)
o.D: Checklist-based testing

items.exEn: BDD expresses desired behaviour as test cases in simple natural language, usually Given/When/Then, understandable by stakeholders and translatable into executable tests.
items.qAr: قبل بدء تطوير user story، يكتب الـ product owner ومطوّر ومختبِر scenarios مثل: «Given السلة فيها 3 عناصر، When المستخدم يحذف عنصرًا، Then يتحدّث مجموع السلة». هذه الـ scenarios سهلة الفهم لأصحاب العمل وتُحوَّل لاحقًا إلى automated tests. أي approach مستخدَم هنا؟
items.exAr: الـ BDD يعبّر عن السلوك المطلوب بـ test cases بلغة طبيعية بسيطة، غالبًا بصيغة Given/When/Then، يفهمها الـ stakeholders ويمكن تحويلها إلى tests قابلة للتنفيذ.

items.q: An organization is moving to DevOps. From a testing perspective, which of the following is a RISK or challenge of this change?

o.A: Developers get faster feedback on the quality of their code
o.B: Automated processes such as CI/CD support a stable test environment
o.C: Testers gain more visibility of non-functional quality characteristics
o.D: Test automation requires additional resources and may be difficult to establish and maintain

items.exEn: Syllabus DevOps risks include defining the delivery pipeline, introducing and maintaining CI/CD tools, and test automation needing extra resources and being hard to establish and maintain.
items.qAr: تنتقل مؤسسة إلى DevOps. من منظور الاختبار، أي مما يلي يُعد risk أو تحديًا لهذا التغيير؟
items.exAr: من مخاطر الـ DevOps: ضرورة تعريف الـ delivery pipeline، وإدخال أدوات CI/CD وصيانتها، وأن الـ test automation يحتاج موارد إضافية وقد يصعب بناؤه وصيانته.

items.q: A team wants to apply a shift-left approach. Which of the following activities is an example of shift-left?

o.A: Starting non-functional testing, such as performance testing, at the component test level
o.B: Postponing security testing until acceptance testing so that the system is complete
o.C: Starting test design only after the code freeze
o.D: Running static analysis only after system testing has finished

items.exEn: Shift-left practices include starting non-functional testing at component level where possible, rather than waiting for later levels.
items.qAr: يريد فريق تطبيق الـ shift-left. أي من الأنشطة التالية مثال على الـ shift-left؟
items.exAr: من ممارسات الـ shift-left أن يبدأ الـ non-functional testing (مثل الـ performance testing) على مستوى الـ component testing متى أمكن، بدل انتظار المستويات اللاحقة.

items.q: A project manager objects to shift-left because testers would need training and extra effort early in the project. Which statement best responds to this concern?

o.A: Shift-left never adds cost at any point in the project
o.B: Shift-left may add effort and cost early, but is expected to save effort and cost later in the process
o.C: Shift-left only moves testing to the end of the lifecycle, so early costs are not affected
o.D: Shift-left removes the need for dynamic testing, which compensates for the training cost

items.exEn: The syllabus notes shift-left may require extra training, effort or cost earlier, but is expected to save effort and cost later; stakeholder buy-in is important.
items.qAr: يعترض project manager على الـ shift-left لأن المختبِرين سيحتاجون تدريبًا وجهدًا إضافيًا في بداية المشروع. أي عبارة تردّ على هذا القلق بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: قد يضيف الـ shift-left جهدًا وتكلفة في البداية، لكن المتوقع أن يوفّر جهدًا وتكلفة لاحقًا في العملية، ومن المهم إقناع الـ stakeholders بذلك.

items.q: During a sprint retrospective, testers point out that many defects came from ambiguous user stories. The team agrees to add a clarity checklist to backlog refinement so that future user stories are clearer. Which benefit of retrospectives does this outcome mainly illustrate?

o.A: Increased quality of testware through joint review of test processes
o.B: Team bonding and learning through raising issues
o.C: Improved quality of the test basis
o.D: Reduced need for regression testing

items.exEn: Addressing deficiencies in the extent and quality of requirements improves the quality of the test basis, a listed benefit of retrospectives.
items.qAr: خلال sprint retrospective، أشار المختبِرون إلى أن كثيرًا من الـ defects جاءت من user stories غامضة، فاتفق الفريق على إضافة checklist للوضوح أثناء الـ backlog refinement لتصبح الـ user stories القادمة أوضح. أي فائدة من فوائد الـ retrospectives توضّحها هذه النتيجة بشكل أساسي؟
items.exAr: معالجة النقص في وضوح المتطلبات وجودتها تحسّن جودة الـ test basis، وهي من فوائد الـ retrospectives.

items.q: An online shop has been fully tested on its own. The team now tests the exchange of data between the shop and an external payment gateway operated by a third party. Which test level is this?

o.A: Component testing
o.B: Component integration testing
o.C: Acceptance testing
o.D: System integration testing

items.exEn: System integration testing focuses on interfaces between the system under test and other systems and external services.
items.qAr: تم اختبار متجر إلكتروني بالكامل بشكل مستقل. يختبر الفريق الآن تبادل البيانات بين المتجر وبوابة دفع خارجية تديرها جهة ثالثة. ما هو هذا الـ test level؟
items.exAr: الـ system integration testing يركّز على الـ interfaces بين النظام قيد الاختبار وأنظمة أخرى أو خدمات خارجية.

items.q: Before go-live, the operations team checks backup and restore, disaster recovery and installation procedures of a new system. Which form of acceptance testing is this?

o.A: Operational acceptance testing
o.B: User acceptance testing
o.C: Contractual acceptance testing
o.D: Beta testing

items.exEn: Operational acceptance testing verifies operational aspects such as backup/restore, disaster recovery, installation and maintenance tasks.
items.qAr: قبل الإطلاق، يفحص فريق العمليات (operations) إجراءات الـ backup والـ restore والـ disaster recovery والتثبيت لنظام جديد. أي شكل من أشكال الـ acceptance testing هذا؟
items.exAr: الـ operational acceptance testing يتحقق من الجوانب التشغيلية مثل الـ backup/restore والـ disaster recovery والتثبيت ومهام الصيانة.

items.q: Which set of attributes is used in the syllabus to distinguish one test level from another?

o.A: Test technique, test tool, test priority and test schedule
o.B: Test object, test objectives, test basis, defects and failures, and approach and responsibilities
o.C: Functional, non-functional, black-box and white-box
o.D: Test cases, test data, test scripts and test logs

items.exEn: Test levels are characterized by test object, test objectives, test basis, typical defects and failures, and approach and responsibilities.
items.qAr: أي مجموعة من الخصائص تُستخدم في الـ syllabus للتمييز بين test level وآخر؟
items.exAr: تتميز الـ test levels بالـ test object والـ test objectives والـ test basis والـ defects والـ failures المتوقعة، والـ approach والمسؤوليات.

items.q:
Match each test to its test type:
1. Checking that the page responds within 2 seconds with 500 concurrent users
2. Checking that a 10% discount is calculated correctly
3. Tests designed to cover all branches of the pricing code
4. Tests derived from the specification without reference to internal structure

o.A: 1-Functional, 2-Non-functional, 3-Black-box, 4-White-box
o.B: 1-Non-functional, 2-Functional, 3-Black-box, 4-White-box
o.C: 1-Non-functional, 2-Functional, 3-White-box, 4-Black-box
o.D: 1-White-box, 2-Black-box, 3-Functional, 4-Non-functional

items.exEn: Response time under load is non-functional, discount correctness is functional, code-structure coverage is white-box, and specification-based tests are black-box.
items.qAr:
طابق كل test مع الـ test type الخاص به:
1. التحقق من أن الصفحة تستجيب خلال ثانيتين مع 500 مستخدم متزامن
2. التحقق من حساب خصم 10% بشكل صحيح
3. tests مصممة لتغطية كل الـ branches في كود التسعير
4. tests مشتقة من الـ specification دون الرجوع إلى البنية الداخلية
items.exAr: زمن الاستجابة تحت الحمل non-functional، وصحة الخصم functional، وتغطية بنية الكود white-box، والـ tests المشتقة من الـ specification هي black-box.

items.q: A tester verifies that a new mobile app keeps working correctly while another app runs on the same device and shares its resources. Which quality characteristic is being tested?

o.A: Functional suitability
o.B: Maintainability
o.C: Portability
o.D: Compatibility

items.exEn: Co-existence with other software in a shared environment is a sub-characteristic of compatibility, a non-functional characteristic.
items.qAr: يتحقق مختبِر من أن تطبيق موبايل جديد يستمر في العمل بشكل صحيح أثناء تشغيل تطبيق آخر على الجهاز نفسه ويشاركه الموارد. أي quality characteristic يتم اختبارها؟
items.exAr: التعايش (co-existence) مع برامج أخرى في بيئة مشتركة من الـ sub-characteristics لـ compatibility، وهي non-functional.

items.q: A defect in the login screen was fixed. The tester reruns the test case that originally failed, then runs existing tests on the profile and checkout features to make sure they were not affected. Which statement correctly describes these two activities?

o.A: The first is confirmation testing; the second is regression testing
o.B: The first is regression testing; the second is confirmation testing
o.C: Both are confirmation testing
o.D: Both are regression testing

items.exEn: Re-running the failed test to check the fix is confirmation testing; checking that unchanged areas were not adversely affected is regression testing.
items.qAr: تم إصلاح defect في شاشة الـ login. يعيد المختبِر تشغيل الـ test case الذي فشل سابقًا، ثم يشغّل tests موجودة على ميزتي الـ profile والـ checkout للتأكد من أنهما لم تتأثرا. أي عبارة تصف هذين النشاطين بشكل صحيح؟
items.exAr: إعادة تشغيل الـ test الذي فشل للتحقق من الإصلاح هي confirmation testing، والتحقق من أن الأجزاء غير المعدّلة لم تتأثر سلبًا هو regression testing.

items.q: A team's regression test suite grows every sprint and is run several times a day in the CI pipeline. What is the most appropriate approach for this suite?

o.A: Run it manually only before each major release
o.B: Automate the regression tests, as they are strong candidates for automation
o.C: Replace it with confirmation testing of fixed defects only
o.D: Stop running it once the number of defects found drops

items.exEn: Regression suites are run many times and usually grow slowly, so they are strong candidates for automation, ideally early and within CI.
items.qAr: تكبر الـ regression test suite لدى فريق مع كل sprint، وتُشغَّل عدة مرات يوميًا في الـ CI pipeline. ما الـ approach الأنسب لهذه الـ suite؟
items.exAr: الـ regression test suites تُشغَّل مرات كثيرة وتكبر تدريجيًا، لذلك هي مرشحة قوية للـ automation، ويُفضَّل أن يبدأ ذلك مبكرًا ضمن الـ CI.

items.q: A bank is retiring a legacy loan system, but regulations require its data to be kept for 10 years. Which maintenance testing is most relevant?

o.A: Performance testing of the legacy system under peak load
o.B: Usability testing of the legacy system's screens
o.C: Testing of data archiving, and of restore and retrieval procedures
o.D: Component testing of the legacy system's source code

items.exEn: When a system is retired and data must be retained long-term, testing of data archiving and of restore and retrieval procedures may be required.
items.qAr: يقوم بنك بإيقاف (retirement) نظام قروض قديم، لكن الأنظمة تتطلب الاحتفاظ ببياناته لمدة 10 سنوات. أي maintenance testing هو الأكثر صلة؟
items.exAr: عند إيقاف نظام مع ضرورة الاحتفاظ ببياناته لفترة طويلة، قد يلزم اختبار أرشفة البيانات (data archiving) وإجراءات الـ restore والاسترجاع.

items.q: A small change is planned for a large, business-critical payroll system in production. Which factors mainly determine the scope of the maintenance testing?

o.A: The number of testers available and the release date
o.B: The SDLC model used when the system was first built
o.C: The test tools that were used during the original development
o.D: The degree of risk of the change, the size of the existing system and the size of the change

items.exEn: The scope of maintenance testing depends on the degree of risk of the change, the size of the existing system and the size of the change.
items.qAr: يُخطَّط لتغيير صغير على نظام رواتب كبير وحرج للأعمال يعمل في الـ production. أي العوامل تحدد بشكل أساسي نطاق الـ maintenance testing؟
items.exAr: نطاق الـ maintenance testing يعتمد على درجة الـ risk في التغيير، وحجم النظام الحالي، وحجم التغيير.

items.q: A company wants to apply static testing to all work products of a new project. For which of the following is static testing generally NOT appropriate?

o.A: A third-party executable library that, for legal reasons, must not be analysed
o.B: The user stories and their acceptance criteria
o.C: The test plan and test cases
o.D: The source code written by the internal team

items.exEn: Almost any readable work product can be statically tested, except those hard to interpret or that should not be analysed, e.g. third-party executable code for legal reasons.
items.qAr: شركة تريد تطبيق static testing على كل الـ work products في مشروع جديد. على أيٍّ من التالية لا يكون static testing مناسبًا بشكل عام؟
items.exAr: يمكن عمل static testing لأي work product قابل للقراءة تقريبًا، باستثناء ما يصعب تفسيره أو ما لا يجوز تحليله، مثل كود تنفيذي لطرف ثالث لأسباب قانونية.

items.q: Which statement BEST describes a difference between static testing and dynamic testing?

o.A: Static testing can only be performed by tools, while dynamic testing is always manual
o.B: Static testing finds defects directly in work products, while dynamic testing causes failures from which the defects are later found by analysis
o.C: Static testing can only be applied to executable code, while dynamic testing applies to any work product
o.D: Static testing is performed only after dynamic testing is completed

items.exEn: Static testing finds defects directly; dynamic testing causes failures and the associated defects are found through subsequent analysis.
items.qAr: أي عبارة تصف بشكل أفضل فرقًا بين static testing وdynamic testing؟
items.exAr: الـ static testing يجد الـ defects مباشرة، أما الـ dynamic testing فيُسبّب failures ثم نصل إلى الـ defects المرتبطة بها عبر التحليل لاحقًا.

items.q: A team wants to evaluate two quality characteristics of a new module: (1) how easy the code will be to modify in the future, and (2) how fast it responds under peak load. Which statement is correct?

o.A: Both characteristics can only be measured by dynamic testing
o.B: Both characteristics can be fully measured by static testing
o.C: Characteristic (1) can be evaluated by static testing; characteristic (2) requires dynamic testing
o.D: Characteristic (2) can be evaluated by static testing; characteristic (1) requires dynamic testing

items.exEn: Static testing can measure characteristics not dependent on executing code, such as maintainability; performance efficiency depends on execution, so it needs dynamic testing.
items.qAr: فريق يريد تقييم خاصيتين من خصائص الجودة لـ module جديد: (1) مدى سهولة تعديل الكود مستقبلًا، و(2) سرعة الاستجابة تحت الحمل الأعلى. أي عبارة صحيحة؟
items.exAr: الـ static testing يقيس خصائص لا تعتمد على تشغيل الكود مثل الـ maintainability، أما الـ performance efficiency فتعتمد على التشغيل وتحتاج dynamic testing.

items.q:
During reviews of a project's work products, the following issues were found:
i. An interface specification uses kilometres while the consuming component expects miles
ii. One acceptance criterion of a user story has no test case covering it
iii. A variable is used before a value is assigned to it
iv. The system crashes intermittently when two users save at the same moment
Which of these are typically found more easily by static testing than by dynamic testing?

o.A: i and iv
o.B: ii and iv
o.C: iii and iv
o.D: i, ii and iii

items.exEn: Incorrect interface specifications, gaps in test basis coverage and undefined variables are typical static-testing findings; an intermittent crash at run time is a failure observed in dynamic testing.
items.qAr: أثناء مراجعة الـ work products في مشروع، تم إيجاد المشكلات المذكورة في السؤال (i: وحدات قياس غير متطابقة في interface specification، ii: acceptance criterion بدون test case، iii: متغير يُستخدم قبل إعطائه قيمة، iv: النظام ينهار أحيانًا عند الحفظ المتزامن). أيّها يُكتشف عادةً بسهولة أكبر بالـ static testing مقارنةً بالـ dynamic testing؟
items.exAr: الـ interface specification الخاطئة والفجوات في تغطية الـ test basis والمتغيرات بلا قيمة هي نتائج نموذجية للـ static testing، أما الانهيار المتقطع أثناء التشغيل فهو failure يظهر في الـ dynamic testing.

items.q: A team showed the product to business stakeholders for the first time just before release. The stakeholders rejected several features, causing costly rework and missed deadlines. What is the MAIN benefit that early and frequent stakeholder feedback would have provided?

o.A: It would have prevented misunderstandings about requirements and allowed changes to be understood and implemented earlier
o.B: It would have removed the need for dynamic testing
o.C: It would have guaranteed that the product contains no defects
o.D: It would have allowed the team to skip writing acceptance criteria

items.exEn: Early and frequent stakeholder feedback allows early communication of quality problems, prevents requirement misunderstandings and helps implement changes earlier, avoiding costly rework.
items.qAr: فريق عرض المنتج على الـ business stakeholders لأول مرة قبل الـ release مباشرةً، فرفضوا عدة features مما سبّب rework مكلفًا وتأخرًا عن المواعيد. ما الفائدة الرئيسية التي كان سيوفّرها الحصول على feedback مبكر ومتكرر من الـ stakeholders؟
items.exAr: الـ feedback المبكر والمتكرر من الـ stakeholders يمنع سوء فهم الـ requirements ويسمح بفهم التغييرات وتنفيذها مبكرًا، فيتجنب الفريق الـ rework المكلف.

items.q: Before a review starts, the team defines its scope, its purpose, the quality characteristics to be evaluated, the focus areas, the exit criteria and the effort and timeframes. In which review activity does this take place?

o.A: Review initiation
o.B: Planning
o.C: Individual review
o.D: Communication and analysis

items.exEn: During planning, the scope of the review, including purpose, work product, quality characteristics, focus areas, exit criteria, effort and timeframes, is defined.
items.qAr: قبل بدء الـ review، يحدّد الفريق نطاقه والغرض منه وخصائص الجودة المراد تقييمها ومجالات التركيز والـ exit criteria والجهد والإطار الزمني. في أي نشاط من أنشطة الـ review يحدث ذلك؟
items.exAr: في نشاط الـ planning يتم تحديد نطاق الـ review بما فيه الغرض والـ work product وخصائص الجودة ومجالات التركيز والـ exit criteria والجهد والوقت.

items.q: The review leader checks that every reviewer has access to the requirements document, understands their role and responsibilities, and has received the checklist they will use. Which review activity is this?

o.A: Planning
o.B: Individual review
o.C: Review initiation
o.D: Fixing and reporting

items.exEn: Review initiation aims to make sure everyone involved is prepared: they have access to the work product, understand their role and have everything needed to perform the review.
items.qAr: قائد الـ review يتأكد أن كل reviewer لديه صلاحية الوصول إلى وثيقة الـ requirements ويفهم دوره ومسؤولياته واستلم الـ checklist التي سيستخدمها. أي نشاط من أنشطة الـ review هذا؟
items.exAr: الهدف من الـ review initiation هو التأكد من جاهزية كل المشاركين: الوصول إلى الـ work product وفهم أدوارهم وتوفّر كل ما يلزم لتنفيذ الـ review.

items.q: In a review meeting, participants discuss the anomalies found, decide the status and ownership of each one and agree on whether the work product needs rework. Which review activity is being performed?

o.A: Planning
o.B: Individual review
o.C: Fixing and reporting
o.D: Communication and analysis

items.exEn: In communication and analysis, anomalies are analysed and discussed, their status and ownership are decided, and a review decision is made.
items.qAr: في اجتماع الـ review يناقش المشاركون الـ anomalies التي تم إيجادها، ويقرّرون حالة كل واحدة ومن المسؤول عنها، ويتفقون على ما إذا كان الـ work product يحتاج إلى rework. أي نشاط من أنشطة الـ review يتم تنفيذه؟
items.exAr: في نشاط الـ communication and analysis يتم تحليل الـ anomalies ومناقشتها وتحديد حالتها ومالكها واتخاذ قرار الـ review.

items.q: After the review meeting, a defect report is created for each confirmed defect, the author updates the work product until the exit criteria are met, and the review results are reported. Which review activity is this?

o.A: Fixing and reporting
o.B: Communication and analysis
o.C: Review initiation
o.D: Individual review

items.exEn: In fixing and reporting, defect reports are created for defects requiring changes, fixes are made until exit criteria are reached, the work product is accepted and the results are reported.
items.qAr: بعد اجتماع الـ review، يتم إنشاء defect report لكل defect مؤكد، ويحدّث الـ author الـ work product حتى تتحقق الـ exit criteria، ثم يتم الإبلاغ عن نتائج الـ review. أي نشاط من أنشطة الـ review هذا؟
items.exAr: في نشاط الـ fixing and reporting يتم إنشاء الـ defect reports وإجراء الإصلاحات حتى تتحقق الـ exit criteria وقبول الـ work product والإبلاغ عن النتائج.

items.q: A project needs to decide which of its design documents will be reviewed this sprint and to allocate staff and time for those reviews. Which review role is responsible for this?

o.A: Review leader
o.B: Manager
o.C: Moderator (facilitator)
o.D: Author

items.exEn: The manager is responsible for deciding what is to be reviewed and for providing resources such as staff and time.
items.qAr: مشروع يحتاج أن يقرّر أي وثائق الـ design ستتم مراجعتها في هذا الـ sprint، وأن يخصّص الأشخاص والوقت لهذه المراجعات. أي دور من أدوار الـ review مسؤول عن ذلك؟
items.exAr: الـ manager هو المسؤول عن تحديد ما ستتم مراجعته وتوفير الموارد مثل الأشخاص والوقت.

items.q: In a review, one person takes overall responsibility for the review, decides who will be involved, and organises when and where the review will take place. Which role is this?

o.A: Scribe (recorder)
o.B: Reviewer
o.C: Review leader
o.D: Manager

items.exEn: The review leader takes overall responsibility for the review, such as deciding who will be involved and organising when and where it will take place.
items.qAr: في الـ review، شخص واحد يتحمّل المسؤولية الكاملة عن الـ review، ويقرّر من سيشارك، وينظّم متى وأين ستُعقد. ما هذا الدور؟
items.exAr: الـ review leader يتحمّل المسؤولية الكاملة عن الـ review، مثل تحديد المشاركين وتنظيم وقت ومكان انعقادها.

items.q: Several architects disagree about how a new caching component should be designed. They want technically qualified peers to examine the proposal so the group can reach consensus and make a decision on the technical problem. Which review type BEST fits this situation?

o.A: Informal review
o.B: Walkthrough
o.C: Inspection
o.D: Technical review

items.exEn: A technical review is performed by technically qualified reviewers and led by a moderator; its objectives are to gain consensus and make decisions regarding a technical problem.
items.qAr: عدة architects يختلفون حول طريقة تصميم component جديد للـ caching، ويريدون أن يفحص زملاء مؤهلون تقنيًا هذا الاقتراح حتى تصل المجموعة إلى توافق وتتخذ قرارًا في المشكلة التقنية. أي نوع review يناسب هذا الموقف أكثر؟
items.exAr: الـ technical review يقوم به reviewers مؤهلون تقنيًا ويقودها moderator، وهدفها الوصول إلى توافق واتخاذ قرارات بخصوص مشكلة تقنية.

items.q: A team is organising an inspection of a requirements specification written by Sara. Who must NOT act as the scribe for this inspection?

o.A: Sara, the author of the specification
o.B: A tester who is also a reviewer
o.C: A business analyst from another team
o.D: A trained moderator from the QA department

items.exEn: In an inspection, the author cannot act as the review leader or the scribe.
items.qAr: فريق ينظّم inspection لوثيقة requirements specification كتبتها سارة. من الذي لا يجوز أن يكون الـ scribe في هذه الـ inspection؟
items.exAr: في الـ inspection لا يجوز أن يكون الـ author هو الـ review leader أو الـ scribe.

items.q: A manager plans to use the number of anomalies found in each developer's code during reviews to rate the developers' individual performance. How is this MOST likely to affect the reviews?

o.A: It will improve reviews, because evaluating participants is a key review objective
o.B: It will undermine reviews, because evaluating participants should never be an objective of a review
o.C: It will have no effect, because review results are confidential
o.D: It will improve reviews, because authors will submit larger work products at once

items.exEn: A success factor for reviews is having clear objectives and measurable exit criteria; evaluation of participants should never be an objective.
items.qAr: مدير يخطّط لاستخدام عدد الـ anomalies التي تُكتشف في كود كل developer أثناء الـ reviews لتقييم أدائه الفردي. ما الأثر الأكثر احتمالًا لذلك على الـ reviews؟
items.exAr: من عوامل نجاح الـ reviews وجود أهداف واضحة وexit criteria قابلة للقياس، ولا يجوز أبدًا أن يكون تقييم المشاركين هدفًا من أهداف الـ review.

items.q: A cinema sets ticket prices by age in whole years: 0–2 free, 3–12 child, 13–64 adult, 65–120 senior. Ages below 0 or above 120 are rejected. What is the minimum number of test cases needed to cover all valid and invalid equivalence partitions?
items.exEn: 4 valid partitions (0–2, 3–12, 13–64, 65–120) + 2 invalid partitions (<0, >120) = 6 test cases.
items.qAr: تحدد سينما سعر التذكرة وفق العمر بالسنوات الكاملة: 0–2 مجانًا، و3–12 طفل، و13–64 بالغ، و65–120 كبير سن. وتُرفض الأعمار الأقل من 0 أو الأكثر من 120. ما أقل عدد من الـ test cases اللازمة لتغطية جميع الـ equivalence partitions الصالحة وغير الصالحة؟
items.exAr: لدينا 4 partitions صالحة (0–2، 3–12، 13–64، 65–120) و2 غير صالحين (أقل من 0، أكثر من 120)، أي 6 test cases.

items.q: A hotel booking form has two inputs: 'Room type' with valid partitions Single, Double and Suite, and 'Breakfast' with valid partitions Yes and No. Every test case sets both inputs. What is the minimum number of test cases needed so that every partition of each input is covered at least once?
items.exEn: Each test covers one partition of each input at the same time, so the input with most partitions (Room type: 3) sets the minimum: 3 tests.
items.qAr: يحتوي نموذج حجز فندق على مدخلين: «Room type» وله partitions صالحة هي Single وDouble وSuite، و«Breakfast» وله partitions صالحة هي Yes وNo. وكل test case تعبّئ المدخلين معًا. ما أقل عدد من الـ test cases لتغطية كل partition لكل مدخل مرة واحدة على الأقل؟
items.exAr: تغطي كل test في الوقت نفسه partition من كل مدخل، لذا يحدد المدخل الأكثر partitions (Room type: 3) الحد الأدنى: 3 tests.

items.q: An electricity bill uses whole kWh values: 0–200 is tier 1, 201–500 is tier 2 and above 500 is tier 3. Negative values are rejected. Tests are executed with 50, 150 and 600 kWh. What equivalence partition coverage is achieved, counting the invalid partition?
items.exEn: There are 4 partitions (<0, 0–200, 201–500, >500); 50 and 150 hit the same partition and 600 hits >500, so 2 of 4 = 50%.
items.qAr: تستخدم فاتورة الكهرباء قيم kWh صحيحة: 0–200 الشريحة الأولى، و201–500 الشريحة الثانية، وما فوق 500 الشريحة الثالثة. وتُرفض القيم السالبة. نُفّذت tests بالقيم 50 و150 و600 kWh. ما نسبة الـ equivalence partition coverage المتحققة، مع احتساب الـ partition غير الصالح؟
items.exAr: توجد 4 partitions (أقل من 0، 0–200، 201–500، أكثر من 500)؛ تقع 50 و150 في الـ partition نفسه و600 في الـ partition الأخير، أي 2 من 4 = 50%.

items.q: A car park charges by whole minutes: 0–30 free, 31–120 $2, 121–240 $5. Durations below 0 or above 240 are rejected. Using 2-value boundary value analysis, how many boundary values (coverage items) are there, including those in invalid partitions?
items.exEn: Boundary values are the min and max of each partition: −1 | 0, 30 | 31, 120 | 121, 240 | 241 = 8 coverage items.
items.qAr: يحسب موقف سيارات الأجرة بالدقائق الكاملة: 0–30 مجانًا، و31–120 بـ 2$، و121–240 بـ 5$. وتُرفض المدد الأقل من 0 أو الأكثر من 240. باستخدام 2-value boundary value analysis، كم boundary value (coverage item) لدينا، بما فيها تلك الواقعة في الـ partitions غير الصالحة؟
items.exAr: الـ boundary values هي أصغر قيمة وأكبر قيمة في كل partition: ‎−1 | 0، 30 | 31، 120 | 121، 240 | 241 = 8 coverage items.

items.q: A restaurant app applies a happy-hour discount to orders placed from 17:00 to 18:59 inclusive (times in whole minutes). Using 2-value boundary value analysis, which set of order times covers all boundary values of the discount period?
items.exEn: 2-value BVA tests each boundary and its closest neighbour in the adjacent partition: 16:59/17:00 and 18:59/19:00.
items.qAr: يطبّق تطبيق مطعم خصم happy hour على الطلبات من 17:00 حتى 18:59 ضمنًا (الوقت بالدقائق الكاملة). باستخدام 2-value boundary value analysis، أي مجموعة أوقات تغطي جميع الـ boundary values لفترة الخصم؟
items.exAr: تفحص الـ 2-value BVA كل حد مع أقرب جار له في الـ partition المجاور: 16:59/17:00 و18:59/19:00.

items.q: A water tank sensor shows 'Low' for levels below 20, 'Normal' for 20–80 and 'High' above 80 (whole numbers). Using 3-value boundary value analysis as defined in CTFL v4.0, which value is NOT a coverage item for the boundary between Low and Normal?
items.exEn: 19 and 20 are both boundary values; each is tested with both neighbours, giving 18, 19, 20, 21 — so 22 is not needed.
items.qAr: يعرض حسّاس خزان مياه «Low» للمستويات الأقل من 20، و«Normal» من 20–80، و«High» لما فوق 80 (أعداد صحيحة). باستخدام 3-value boundary value analysis وفق تعريف CTFL v4.0، أي قيمة ليست coverage item للحد بين Low وNormal؟
items.exAr: كلٌّ من 19 و20 boundary value، وتُفحص كل منهما مع جارتيها، فتكون القيم 18 و19 و20 و21، أي أن 22 غير مطلوبة.

items.q: A discount code must be 6 to 10 characters long; shorter or longer codes are rejected. Consider only the two boundaries of the valid partition (between 'too short' and 'valid', and between 'valid' and 'too long'). Using 3-value boundary value analysis as defined in CTFL v4.0, how many DISTINCT code lengths must be tested?
items.exEn: Boundary values are 5, 6, 10, 11; each with both neighbours gives 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9, 10, 11, 12 = 8 distinct lengths.
items.qAr: يجب أن يكون طول كود الخصم من 6 إلى 10 أحرف، ويُرفض الأقصر أو الأطول. باعتبار الحدّين بين الـ partition الصالح والـ partitions غير الصالحة فقط (قصير جدًا / صالح، وصالح / طويل جدًا)، وباستخدام 3-value boundary value analysis حسب CTFL v4.0، كم طولًا مختلفًا يجب اختباره؟
items.exAr: الـ boundary values هي 5 و6 و10 و11؛ كل وحدة مع جيرانها الاثنين بتعطي 4، 5، 6، 7 و9، 10، 11، 12 = 8 أطوال مختلفة.

items.q: A car insurance premium depends on three conditions: vehicle type (car, motorbike or truck), driver under 25 (Y/N) and previous claims (Y/N). How many columns does the FULL decision table contain if all combinations are feasible?
items.exEn: The full table has one column per combination: 3 × 2 × 2 = 12.
items.qAr: يعتمد قسط تأمين السيارة على ثلاثة conditions: نوع المركبة (car أو motorbike أو truck)، وكون السائق أقل من 25 سنة (Y/N)، ووجود مطالبات سابقة (Y/N). كم column يحتوي الـ decision table الكامل إذا كانت جميع التوليفات ممكنة؟
items.exAr: يحتوي الجدول الكامل على column لكل توليفة: 3 × 2 × 2 = 12.

items.q:
A minimised decision table for loan requests has four rules ('–' = does not matter):
R1: Employed = Y, Good credit = Y, Guarantor = – → Approve
R2: Employed = Y, Good credit = N, Guarantor = – → Refer
R3: Employed = N, Good credit = –, Guarantor = Y → Refer
R4: Employed = N, Good credit = –, Guarantor = N → Reject
Which test case has the correct expected result?

o.A: Employed = N, Good credit = Y, Guarantor = N → Approve
o.B: Employed = Y, Good credit = N, Guarantor = Y → Refer
o.C: Employed = N, Good credit = Y, Guarantor = Y → Approve
o.D: Employed = Y, Good credit = Y, Guarantor = N → Refer

items.exEn: Employed = Y and Good credit = N matches R2 (Guarantor does not matter), so the expected result is Refer.
items.qAr: عندنا decision table مختصر لطلبات القروض فيه أربع rules (الرمز «–» يعني ما بتفرق)، مكتوبة بالسؤال الإنجليزي فوق. أي test case نتيجتها المتوقعة صحيحة؟
items.exAr: ‏Employed = Y وGood credit = N بتطابق R2 (والـ Guarantor ما بتفرق)، فالنتيجة المتوقعة Refer.

items.q:
A minimised decision table for a library loan has four rules (conditions: Member, Overdue items, Reserved by another reader; '–' = does not matter):
R1: N, –, – → Refuse
R2: Y, Y, – → Refuse
R3: Y, N, Y → Waitlist
R4: Y, N, N → Lend
Tests executed (Member, Overdue, Reserved): T1 (N, Y, N), T2 (Y, N, N), T3 (N, N, Y), T4 (Y, Y, Y). What decision table coverage is achieved?
items.exEn: T1 and T3 → R1, T2 → R4, T4 → R2; R3 is never exercised, so 3 of 4 rules = 75%.
items.qAr: لدينا decision table مختصر لاستعارة الكتب من مكتبة يتضمن أربع rules، والـ tests المنفّذة مذكورة في السؤال بالإنجليزية أعلاه. ما نسبة الـ decision table coverage المتحققة؟
items.exAr: ‏T1 وT3 ← R1، وT2 ← R4، وT4 ← R2؛ ولم تُفحص R3 إطلاقًا، أي 3 من 4 = 75%.

items.q: A lift door has four states: Closed, Opening, Open and Closing, with five valid transitions: Closed → Opening (open request), Opening → Open (fully opened), Open → Closing (timer expires), Closing → Closed (fully closed), Closing → Opening (obstacle detected). One test is executed: Closed → Opening → Open → Closing → Closed. What all states coverage and valid transitions coverage does it achieve?

o.A: 75% all states, 80% valid transitions
o.B: 80% all states, 100% valid transitions
o.C: 100% all states, 100% valid transitions
o.D: 100% all states, 80% valid transitions

items.exEn: All 4 states are visited (100%); 4 of 5 transitions are exercised because Closing → Opening is missing (80%).
items.qAr: لباب مصعد أربع states: Closed وOpening وOpen وClosing، وخمسة transitions صالحة: Closed → Opening (طلب فتح)، وOpening → Open (انفتح بالكامل)، وOpen → Closing (انتهاء المؤقت)، وClosing → Closed (أُغلق بالكامل)، وClosing → Opening (اكتشاف عائق). نُفّذ test واحد: Closed → Opening → Open → Closing → Closed. ما نسبة الـ all states coverage والـ valid transitions coverage المتحققة؟
items.exAr: زِيرت جميع الـ states الأربع (100%)، وفُحص 4 من 5 transitions لأن Closing → Opening لم يُغطَّ (80%).

items.q: A subscription has states Trial, Active, Suspended and Closed (final), with six valid transitions: Trial → Active (pay), Trial → Closed (trial expires), Active → Suspended (payment fails), Suspended → Active (payment updated), Suspended → Closed (unpaid for 30 days), Active → Closed (user cancels). Each test case must start in Trial and end in Closed. What is the minimum number of test cases needed for 100% valid transitions coverage?
items.exEn: Each test ends with exactly one of the 3 transitions into Closed, so at least 3 are needed; e.g. Trial→Closed; Trial→Active→Suspended→Active→Closed; Trial→Active→Suspended→Closed.
items.qAr: لاشتراك الـ states الآتية: Trial وActive وSuspended وClosed (نهائية)، وستة transitions صالحة: Trial → Active (دفع)، وTrial → Closed (انتهاء التجربة)، وActive → Suspended (فشل الدفع)، وSuspended → Active (تحديث الدفع)، وSuspended → Closed (عدم الدفع 30 يومًا)، وActive → Closed (إلغاء المستخدم). يجب أن تبدأ كل test case من Trial وتنتهي بـ Closed. ما أقل عدد من الـ test cases لتحقيق 100% valid transitions coverage؟
items.exAr: تنتهي كل test بواحد فقط من الـ transitions الثلاثة التي تدخل Closed، لذا يلزم 3 على الأقل؛ مثلًا Trial→Closed وTrial→Active→Suspended→Active→Closed وTrial→Active→Suspended→Closed.

items.q: A smart heater has three states (Off, Standby, Heating) and three events (power, start, stop). The only valid transitions are: Off –power→ Standby, Standby –power→ Off, Standby –start→ Heating, Heating –stop→ Standby. In a complete state table, how many invalid transitions (state/event combinations with no defined transition) are there?
items.exEn: The state table has 3 states × 3 events = 9 cells; 4 are valid, so 9 − 4 = 5 invalid transitions.
items.qAr: لسخّان ذكي ثلاث states (Off وStandby وHeating) وثلاثة events (power وstart وstop). والـ transitions الصالحة الوحيدة هي: Off –power→ Standby، وStandby –power→ Off، وStandby –start→ Heating، وHeating –stop→ Standby. في الـ state table الكامل، كم invalid transition (توليفة state/event بلا transition معرّف) يوجد؟
items.exAr: يحتوي الـ state table على 3 states × 3 events = 9 خانات، منها 4 صالحة، أي 9 − 4 = 5 invalid transitions.

items.q: A subscription has states Trial, Active, Suspended and Closed, with valid transitions: Trial → Active (pay), Trial → Closed (trial expires), Active → Suspended (payment fails), Suspended → Active (payment updated), Suspended → Closed (unpaid for 30 days), Active → Closed (user cancels). Which test case checks an INVALID transition?

o.A: In Trial, trigger 'payment fails' and check that it is rejected and the state stays Trial
o.B: In Suspended, trigger 'payment updated' and check the state becomes Active
o.C: In Active, trigger 'user cancels' and check the state becomes Closed
o.D: In Trial, trigger 'trial expires' and check the state becomes Closed

items.exEn: No transition is defined for 'payment fails' in state Trial, so that test exercises an invalid transition; the others are valid transitions.
items.qAr: لاشتراك الـ states الآتية: Trial وActive وSuspended وClosed، مع الـ transitions الصالحة المذكورة في السؤال بالإنجليزية أعلاه. أي test case تفحص INVALID transition؟
items.exAr: لا يوجد transition معرّف للحدث «payment fails» في الـ state Trial، لذا تفحص هذه الـ test حالة invalid transition؛ أما البقية فهي valid transitions.

items.q:
Consider this code (all lines except 'end if' are executable statements):
1  read age
2  read member
3  fee = 10
4  if age < 12 then
5      fee = 5
6  end if
7  if member = "Y" then
8      fee = fee - 2
9  end if
10 print fee
Which single test case achieves 100% statement coverage?

o.A: age = 10, member = "N"
o.B: age = 15, member = "Y"
o.C: age = 15, member = "N"
o.D: age = 10, member = "Y"

items.exEn: Lines 5 and 8 run only when age < 12 AND member = "Y", so age = 10 with member = "Y" executes every statement.
items.qAr: في الكود أعلاه (جميع الأسطر ما عدا «end if» هي executable statements)، أي test case واحدة تحقق 100% statement coverage؟
items.exAr: لا يُنفَّذ السطران 5 و8 إلا عندما يتحقق age < 12 وmember = "Y" معًا، لذا فإن age = 10 مع member = "Y" تنفّذ جميع الـ statements.

items.q: An acceptance criterion states: 'Given a user has entered a wrong password 3 consecutive times, when they try to log in again, then the account is locked for 15 minutes.' Which pair of test cases checks both sides of the lockout threshold?

o.A: 3 wrong passwords then the correct one → locked; 5 wrong passwords → locked
o.B: 1 wrong password then the correct one → logged in; 2 wrong passwords then the correct one → logged in
o.C: 2 wrong passwords then the correct one → logged in; 3 wrong passwords then the correct one → account locked for 15 minutes
o.D: 3 wrong passwords → locked; correct password after 15 minutes → still locked

items.exEn: The threshold is 3 attempts: 2 failures must not lock and 3 failures must lock, so this pair tests just below and at the threshold.
items.qAr: ينص معيار قبول على: «Given أدخل المستخدم كلمة مرور خاطئة 3 مرات متتالية، when يحاول تسجيل الدخول مرة أخرى، then يُقفل الحساب لمدة 15 دقيقة». أي زوج من الـ test cases يفحص جانبي حد القفل؟
items.exAr: الحد هو 3 محاولات: يجب ألا تؤدي محاولتان خاطئتان إلى قفل الحساب وأن تؤدي 3 إلى قفله، لذا يفحص هذا الزوج ما دون الحد والحد نفسه تمامًا.

items.q: User story: 'As a shopper, I want to choose express delivery.' Acceptance criteria: express delivery is offered only for orders placed before 14:00; it costs $8; it is not offered if the cart contains an item marked 'bulky'. Which test case is NOT derived from these acceptance criteria?

o.A: Order at 13:59 with no bulky items → express offered at $8
o.B: Order at 10:00 paid with a gift card → gift card balance reduced by the order total
o.C: Order at 14:00 with no bulky items → express not offered
o.D: Order at 10:00 containing a bulky item → express not offered

items.exEn: The gift card payment is not covered by any of the three criteria (cut-off time, price, bulky items); the other tests each check one criterion.
items.qAr: User story: «As a shopper, I want to choose express delivery». معايير القبول: التوصيل السريع متاح فقط للطلبات قبل الساعة 14:00، وسعره 8$، وغير متاح إذا احتوت السلة على منتج معلَّم «bulky». أي test case غير مشتقة من معايير القبول هذه؟
items.exAr: الدفع بالـ gift card غير مغطى بأي من المعايير الثلاثة (وقت الإغلاق، السعر، المنتجات الـ bulky)؛ أما بقية الـ tests فتفحص كلٌّ منها معيارًا.

items.q: A tester derives test cases only from the requirements specification, without looking at the code. How is coverage measured for these tests?

o.A: As the proportion of items in the test basis (e.g. partitions, rules) exercised by the tests
o.B: As the percentage of executable statements executed
o.C: As the number of defects found per test case
o.D: It cannot be measured, because the code is not examined

items.exEn: For black-box techniques, coverage is measured against the items identified in the test basis, not against the code.
items.qAr: يشتق مختبِر الـ test cases من الـ requirements specification فقط، دون الاطلاع على الكود. كيف تُقاس الـ coverage لهذه الـ tests؟
items.exAr: في الـ black-box techniques تُقاس الـ coverage بالنسبة إلى العناصر المحددة في الـ test basis، لا بالنسبة إلى الكود.

items.q: Why are experience-based test techniques useful in addition to black-box and white-box techniques?

o.A: They guarantee full requirements coverage
o.B: They can detect defects that may be missed by the more systematic techniques
o.C: Their effectiveness does not depend on the tester's skills
o.D: They provide a measurable level of code coverage

items.exEn: Experience-based techniques use tester knowledge and intuition, so they complement systematic techniques by finding defects those may miss.
items.qAr: ليش الـ experience-based test techniques مفيدة بالإضافة للـ black-box والـ white-box techniques؟
items.exAr: الـ experience-based techniques بتعتمد على خبرة وحدس المختبِر، فبتكمّل التقنيات المنهجية وبتلاقي defects ممكن تفوتها.

items.q: A specification is vague and partly outdated. Why can white-box testing still be valuable in this situation?

o.A: It derives expected results directly from the specification
o.B: It reliably detects requirements that were never implemented
o.C: Because tests are based on the actual implementation, defects can be found even when the specification is vague, outdated or incomplete
o.D: It removes the need for any black-box testing

items.exEn: White-box tests consider the whole implementation, so they can reveal defects even when specifications are poor.
items.qAr: الـ specification غامضة وقديمة جزئياً. ليش الـ white-box testing ممكن تضل مفيدة بهاد الوضع؟
items.exAr: الـ white-box tests بتعتمد على الـ implementation الفعلي، فبتقدر تكشف defects حتى لو الـ specifications ضعيفة.

items.q: Which problem is a white-box test technique, used on its own, LEAST likely to detect?

o.A: A wrong calculation in a branch that the tests execute
o.B: A statement that can never be reached
o.C: A loop that never ends for a particular input value
o.D: A requirement that was never implemented in the code

items.exEn: White-box tests are derived from the existing code, so they cannot reveal functionality that is missing from it (omissions).
items.qAr: أي مشكلة الـ white-box test technique لحالها أقل احتمال تكشفها؟
items.exAr: الـ white-box tests بتنشتق من الكود الموجود، فما بتقدر تكشف وظائف ناقصة منه أصلاً (omissions).

items.q: A tester compiles a list of possible developer errors, defects and failures (for example division by zero, empty mandatory fields, very long inputs) and then designs tests aimed specifically at exposing each one. Which approach is this?

o.A: Fault attack
o.B: Checklist-based testing
o.C: Session-based exploratory testing
o.D: Equivalence partitioning

items.exEn: Fault attacks are a methodical way to implement error guessing: list possible errors, defects and failures, then design tests to expose them.
items.qAr: يُعدّ مختبِر قائمة بالأخطاء والـ defects والـ failures المحتملة من المطورين (مثل القسمة على صفر، والحقول الإجبارية الفارغة، والمدخلات الطويلة جدًا)، ثم يصمم tests هدفها كشف كلٍّ منها. ما اسم هذا الأسلوب؟
items.exAr: الـ fault attack طريقة منهجية لتطبيق الـ error guessing: نُعدّ قائمة بالأخطاء والـ defects والـ failures المحتملة ونصمم tests تكشفها.

items.q: In session-based exploratory testing, what does a test charter contain?

o.A: A detailed step-by-step test procedure with expected results
o.B: Test objectives that guide the tester during a time-boxed session
o.C: The list of defects found during the session
o.D: The code coverage targets for the session

items.exEn: A test charter states the test objectives that guide the exploratory session; results are discussed in a debriefing afterwards.
items.qAr: في الـ session-based exploratory testing، ماذا يتضمن الـ test charter؟
items.exAr: يحدد الـ test charter أهداف الاختبار التي توجّه الـ session الاستكشافية، وتُناقش النتائج بعدها في الـ debriefing.

items.q: In which situation is exploratory testing MOST appropriate?

o.A: A regulator requires fully pre-documented test procedures with traceable steps
o.B: A stable, fully specified system needs an automated regression suite
o.C: Specifications are few or inadequate and there is significant time pressure
o.D: The goal is to measure branch coverage of a module

items.exEn: Exploratory testing is most useful when specifications are few or inadequate or under time pressure, and to complement formal techniques.
items.qAr: في أي موقف يكون الـ exploratory testing هو الأنسب؟
items.exAr: يكون الـ exploratory testing أكثر فائدة عندما تكون الـ specifications قليلة أو ناقصة أو عند وجود ضغط في الوقت، وكمكمّل للتقنيات الرسمية.

items.q: Which item is LEAST suitable to include in a checklist for checklist-based testing?

o.A: Does each error message tell the user how to correct the input?
o.B: Are all date fields displayed in the agreed format?
o.C: Can the user cancel every multi-step process before final confirmation?
o.D: Is the application of good quality?

items.exEn: Checklist items should be specific and checkable; items that are too general, like 'good quality', should be avoided.
items.qAr: أي عنصر هو الأقل ملاءمة لإدراجه في checklist خاصة بالـ checklist-based testing؟
items.exAr: يجب أن تكون عناصر الـ checklist محددة وقابلة للفحص؛ وينبغي تجنب العناصر العامة جدًا مثل «جودة جيدة».

items.q: In the '3 C's' of user stories, what does 'Confirmation' refer to?

o.A: The acceptance criteria
o.B: The written description of the story on a card
o.C: The discussion about how the software will be used
o.D: The product owner's signature on the release

items.exEn: Card = the story description, Conversation = the discussion, Confirmation = the acceptance criteria.
items.qAr: في «3 C's» الخاصة بالـ user stories، ما المقصود بـ «Confirmation»؟
items.exAr: ‏Card = وصف الـ story، وConversation = النقاش، وConfirmation = الـ acceptance criteria.

items.q: A user story says: 'As a user, I want the app to be fast.' Reviewers note that there is no way to check whether the story has been fulfilled. Which INVEST criterion is mainly violated?

o.A: Independent
o.B: Testable
o.C: Negotiable
o.D: Valuable

items.exEn: Without measurable criteria nobody can verify the story is done, so it is not Testable.
items.qAr: تنص User story على: «As a user, I want the app to be fast». لاحظ المراجعون أنه لا توجد طريقة للتحقق من تحقق الـ story. أي معيار من INVEST مخالَف بصورة رئيسية؟
items.exAr: من دون معايير قابلة للقياس لا يستطيع أحد التحقق من اكتمال الـ story، لذا فهي ليست Testable.

items.q: During collaborative user story writing, what is the tester's main contribution?

o.A: Estimating the development effort for each story
o.B: Deciding the business priority of each story
o.C: Exploring what-if scenarios, asking questions and identifying missing details so the story is testable
o.D: Writing the unit tests for each story's code

items.exEn: Testers bring the testing perspective: they question the story, explore alternatives and missing details, and help make it testable.
items.qAr: أثناء الكتابة التعاونية للـ user stories، ما المساهمة الرئيسية للمختبِر؟
items.exAr: يقدّم المختبِر منظور الاختبار: يطرح الأسئلة، ويستكشف السيناريوهات البديلة والتفاصيل الناقصة، ويساعد على أن تكون الـ story قابلة للاختبار.

items.q: A team writes acceptance criteria as a bulleted verification list and an input/output mapping table. Which acceptance criteria format is this?

o.A: Scenario-oriented (Given/When/Then)
o.B: Use case format
o.C: State transition format
o.D: Rule-oriented

items.exEn: Rule-oriented acceptance criteria use formats such as bullet-point verification lists or input-output mapping tables.
items.qAr: يكتب فريق الـ acceptance criteria على شكل قائمة تحقق بنقاط وجدول mapping للمدخلات والمخرجات. ما format الـ acceptance criteria هذا؟
items.exAr: تستخدم الـ rule-oriented acceptance criteria أشكالًا مثل قوائم التحقق بنقاط أو جداول mapping للمدخلات والمخرجات.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT a purpose of acceptance criteria?

o.A: To specify how the code should be structured internally
o.B: To define the scope of the user story
o.C: To reach consensus among the stakeholders
o.D: To describe both positive and negative scenarios

items.exEn: Acceptance criteria define scope, build consensus, describe scenarios and support planning and acceptance testing; they do not prescribe internal code structure.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي ليس من أغراض الـ acceptance criteria؟
items.exAr: تحدد الـ acceptance criteria النطاق، وتساعد على الوصول إلى توافق، وتصف السيناريوهات، وتدعم التخطيط والـ acceptance testing؛ ولا تحدد البنية الداخلية للكود.

items.q: In acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), in which order are test cases typically created?

o.A: Non-functional tests first, then negative tests, then positive tests
o.B: Positive tests first, then negative tests, then non-functional tests
o.C: Negative tests first, then positive tests, with non-functional tests left to the system test level
o.D: All tests at once, after the implementation is finished

items.exEn: In ATDD, tests are written before implementation: typically positive tests first, then negative tests, then non-functional characteristics.
items.qAr: بالـ acceptance test-driven development (ATDD)، بأي ترتيب عادةً بتنكتب الـ test cases؟
items.exAr: بالـ ATDD الـ tests بتنكتب قبل الـ implementation: عادةً الـ positive tests أول، بعدها الـ negative tests، وآخر شي الخصائص الـ non-functional.

items.q: A test manager is asked why the team should spend time writing a test plan for a new mobile banking release. Which is a benefit of test planning according to the syllabus?

o.A: It forces testers to consider future challenges related to risks, schedules, people, tools and costs
o.B: It guarantees that no defects will remain in the release
o.C: It replaces the need for test monitoring and test control during the project
o.D: It removes the need to communicate with stakeholders once the plan is approved

items.exEn: Test planning guides testers' thinking and forces them to confront future challenges (risks, schedules, people, tools, costs); it does not remove monitoring, control or communication.
items.qAr: يُسأل مدير الاختبار عن سبب تخصيص الفريق وقتًا لكتابة test plan لإصدار جديد من تطبيق بنكي على الجوال. أي مما يلي يُعدّ فائدة لتخطيط الاختبار وفق المنهج؟
items.exAr: تخطيط الاختبار يوجّه تفكير المختبِرين ويجبرهم على مواجهة التحديات المستقبلية المتعلقة بالمخاطر والجداول والأشخاص والأدوات والتكاليف، ولا يلغي الـ monitoring أو الـ control أو التواصل.

items.q: During iteration planning in a Scrum team, which activity is a typical contribution of the tester?

o.A: Approving the product vision and the release budget
o.B: Participating in the detailed risk analysis of user stories and estimating test effort for testing tasks
o.C: Writing the production code for the highest-priority user stories
o.D: Deciding alone which user stories the team commits to

items.exEn: In iteration planning, testers take part in detailed risk analysis of user stories, determine testability, break stories into (testing) tasks and estimate test effort.
items.qAr: أثناء الـ iteration planning في فريق Scrum، أي نشاط يُعدّ مساهمة نموذجية من المختبِر؟
items.exAr: في الـ iteration planning يشارك المختبِر في تحليل المخاطر التفصيلي للـ user stories وتحديد قابليتها للاختبار وتقسيمها إلى مهام وتقدير جهد الاختبار.

items.q: In an Agile team, a user story may only be pulled into the iteration when it has testable acceptance criteria and its dependencies are resolved. It is considered complete only when all its tests pass and the code has been reviewed. How are these two rules best described?

o.A: Both are exit criteria called the Definition of Done
o.B: The first is the Definition of Done and the second is the Definition of Ready
o.C: The first is the Definition of Ready (entry criteria) and the second is the Definition of Done (exit criteria)
o.D: Both are entry criteria called the Definition of Ready

items.exEn: In Agile, entry criteria are often called the Definition of Ready and exit criteria the Definition of Done.
items.qAr: في فريق Agile، لا يمكن سحب الـ user story إلى الـ iteration إلا إذا كانت لها acceptance criteria قابلة للاختبار وتم حل اعتمادياتها، ولا تُعدّ مكتملة إلا عندما تنجح كل اختباراتها ويُراجَع الكود. كيف توصف هاتان القاعدتان بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: في Agile تُسمّى الـ entry criteria عادة Definition of Ready، وتُسمّى الـ exit criteria عادة Definition of Done.

items.q: The planned exit criteria (90% requirements coverage) have not been met, but the testing budget is exhausted. The stakeholders review the remaining risks and accept releasing without further testing. Which statement is correct according to the syllabus?

o.A: Testing must continue regardless, because exit criteria can never be changed
o.B: The release must be cancelled because the exit criteria were not achieved
o.C: Exit criteria only apply to component testing, so they are irrelevant here
o.D: Running out of budget can be a valid exit criterion if the stakeholders have reviewed and accepted the risk of going live

items.exEn: Running out of time or budget can be a valid exit criterion when stakeholders have reviewed and accepted the risk of releasing without further testing.
items.qAr: لم تتحقق الـ exit criteria المخطط لها (تغطية 90% من المتطلبات)، لكن ميزانية الاختبار نفدت. راجع أصحاب المصلحة المخاطر المتبقية ووافقوا على الإصدار دون مزيد من الاختبار. أي العبارات التالية صحيحة وفق المنهج؟
items.exAr: نفاد الوقت أو الميزانية يمكن أن يكون exit criterion مقبولًا إذا راجع أصحاب المصلحة خطر الإطلاق دون اختبار إضافي ووافقوا عليه.

items.q: In an organization, historical data shows that the test effort to development effort ratio on similar projects is 2:5. A new project has an estimated development effort of 350 person-days. Using estimation based on ratios, what is the estimated test effort?

o.A: 140 person-days
o.B: 175 person-days
o.C: 875 person-days
o.D: 210 person-days

items.exEn: Test effort = 350 × 2/5 = 140 person-days.
items.qAr: تُظهر البيانات التاريخية في مؤسسة ما أن نسبة جهد الاختبار إلى جهد التطوير في المشاريع المشابهة هي 2:5. مشروع جديد قُدّر جهد تطويره بـ 350 person-days. باستخدام estimation based on ratios، ما هو جهد الاختبار المقدّر؟
items.exAr: جهد الاختبار = 350 × 2/5 = 140 person-days.

items.q: A tester uses three-point estimation for a testing task. The optimistic estimate is 4 hours, the most likely estimate is 7 hours and the pessimistic estimate is 16 hours. What is the final estimate E?

o.A: 7 hours
o.B: 8 hours
o.C: 9 hours
o.D: 12 hours

items.qAr: يستخدم مختبِر three-point estimation لمهمة اختبار. التقدير المتفائل 4 ساعات، والأكثر احتمالًا 7 ساعات، والمتشائم 16 ساعة. ما هو التقدير النهائي E؟

items.q: For regression testing of a release, the team's three-point estimates are: optimistic a = 5 days, most likely m = 11 days, pessimistic b = 23 days. Using E = (a + 4m + b)/6 and SD = (b − a)/6, how should the estimate be reported?

o.A: 11 ± 3 days
o.B: 13 ± 3 days
o.C: 12 ± 3 days
o.D: 12 ± 18 days

items.qAr: لاختبار الـ regression testing لإصدار ما، كانت تقديرات الفريق بطريقة three-point estimation: المتفائل a = 5 أيام، والأكثر احتمالًا m = 11 يومًا، والمتشائم b = 23 يومًا. باستخدام E = (a + 4m + b)/6 وSD = (b − a)/6، كيف يجب عرض التقدير؟

items.q: An Agile team has completed the testing of 18, 22 and 20 story points in its last three iterations. The test lead uses the average of these values to estimate how much testing can be done in the next iteration. Which estimation technique is being used?

o.A: Wideband Delphi
o.B: Three-point estimation
o.C: Estimation based on ratios
o.D: Extrapolation

items.exEn: Extrapolation uses measurements made as early as possible in the current project (e.g., average velocity of recent iterations) to estimate future work.
items.qAr: أنجز فريق Agile اختبار 18 و22 و20 story points في آخر ثلاث iterations. يستخدم قائد الاختبار متوسط هذه القيم لتقدير حجم الاختبار الممكن في الـ iteration القادمة. أي تقنية تقدير تُستخدم هنا؟
items.exAr: الـ Extrapolation تعتمد على قياسات مبكرة من المشروع الحالي (مثل متوسط الـ velocity لآخر iterations) لتقدير العمل القادم.

items.q: In an Agile team, each member privately selects a card with an effort value for a user story; the cards are revealed together and large differences are discussed before re-estimating. This Planning Poker approach is a variant of which estimation technique?

o.A: Wideband Delphi
o.B: Extrapolation
o.C: Estimation based on ratios
o.D: Three-point estimation

items.exEn: Planning Poker is a variant of Wideband Delphi, an expert-based technique that iterates until consensus.
items.qAr: في فريق Agile، يختار كل عضو بشكل سري بطاقة تحمل قيمة جهد لـ user story، ثم تُكشف البطاقات معًا وتُناقش الفروقات الكبيرة قبل إعادة التقدير. طريقة Planning Poker هذه هي نسخة من أي تقنية تقدير؟
items.exAr: الـ Planning Poker نسخة من Wideband Delphi، وهي تقنية تعتمد على الخبراء وتتكرر حتى الوصول إلى توافق.

items.q:
Test cases have the following priorities (1 = highest) and dependencies:
TC1: priority 2
TC2: priority 1, can run only after TC3
TC3: priority 4
TC4: priority 3, can run only after TC5
TC5: priority 5
